name: What is the process for restoring documents and electronics after a fire?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for restoring documents and electronics after a fire?

acceptedAnswer.text: Restoring documents and electronics after a fire requires specialized techniques to remove soot, smoke residue, and moisture without causing further damage. Documents may undergo drying, cleaning, and deodorization processes. Electronics often require thorough cleaning, testing, and sometimes professional repair to ensure functionality. Our team uses industry-specific methods to salvage as many valuable items as possible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Documents and electronics require specialized cleaning, drying, and deodorization to remove soot and smoke residue and restore functionality.
